selected_evidence.summary: Worker script and systemd unit created, unit verified clean, service started and shown active/running with worker+sleep processes in its cgroup

Directory created and owned by service user; systemctl show confirms ProtectSystem=strict and ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory; only expected files (count, inventory.log) present and owned by inventory-worker
Unit defines NoNewPrivileges=yes and CapabilityBoundingSet=; systemctl show confirms both properties are set on the running unit

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: changed boot identity proves an actual restart occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: post-restart recovery of required service and data
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, inventory-worker.service is enabled and active with a new invocation ID; persisted counter/log continued from prior value (3->4->5) and kept ticking, proving both the service and its confined data survived and resumed

commands.command: getent group inventory-worker || groupadd --system inventory-worker; getent passwd inventory-worker || useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin --gid inventory-worker inventory-worker; id inventory-worker

cat > /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
STATE_DIR=/var/lib/inventory
LOG="$STATE_DIR/inventory.log"
COUNT_FILE="$STATE_DIR/count"

[ -f "$COUNT_FILE" ] || echo 0 > "$COUNT_FILE"

while true; do
  n=$(cat "$COUNT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  n=$((n + 1))
  echo "$n" > "$COUNT_FILE"
  printf '%s tick=%s\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "$n" >> "$LOG"
  sleep 10
done
EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
cat /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh

commands.command:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventory-worker
Group=inventory-worker
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
Restart=on-failure

# Sandboxing: confine writes to /var/lib/inventory, gain no new privileges
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory
StateDirectory=inventory
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectClock=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
RestrictNamespaces=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
SystemCallFilter=@system-service
SystemCallArchitectures=native
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemd-analyze verify inventory-worker.service; echo VERIFY_EXIT=$?
systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service; sleep 3; systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager
